description.value: Cultured self-knitting skin. Fast healing 2 whenever you have not taken damage since the end of your last turn; persistent bleed on you ends one round sooner than it otherwise would.

cinderfall.incomplete: Fast healing 2 conditioned on 'has not taken damage since the end of your last turn' can't be predicated: no roll option tracks 'took damage last turn' for a FastHealing predicate to test against, and granting it unconditionally would misstate a narrower, frequently-suppressed effect as an always-on one (over-applying is worse than under-applying). 'Persistent bleed ends one round sooner' also has no hook: a persistent condition's duration isn't a rule-element-adjustable actor stat.
